text:
Alex: Heads-up — noticed console alerts about 'prefetch variance' on /v1/embeddings route for tenant T123. Batch dims are jumping between 256 and 1536 causing splitter churn. Anyone catch this in canary? :eyes:
Mira: I saw a single alert earlier, didn't have time to dig in. Do we have a repro or sample payload? Can you paste the client request headers+body snippet?
Ben: Repro steps: run local loadgen with two clients, one sends 256-dim embeds and another 1536-dim in same batch. Router currently coalesces by age, not dim. Here's minimal payload (pseudo):
```json
{"requests": [{"id":"a","input":"...","dim":256}, {"id":"b","input":"...","dim":1536}]}
```
Ben: Console log excerpt:
```
WARN router: mixed-dims detected batch=0x7f size=2 dims=[256,1536] action=splitter_spawned
```
infra-bot: alert: 1 new prefeth_variance warning for route /embeds (severity=warning) — metric embed.router.mixed_dims_rate up 4x
Jordan: TL;DR: mixed-dims increase splitter churn and prefetch noise. Options:
- coalesce only when dims equal (safe)
- prefer small-dim fastpath and route large dims to slowpath (costs latency)
- add soft-throttle: if dim variance ratio > 4, spawn separate batch
Jordan: Example soft-throttle config (proto):
```yaml
splitter:
  soft_throttle:
    dim_ratio_threshold: 4
    min_batch_size: 4
```
Mira: telemetry ask: add counters embed.prefetch.mixed_dims_count and embed.prefetch.dim_histogram, and a hist for batch_shedding_ms. Console should surface per-tenant mixed-dim spikes. I can add metrics and dashboard tile.
Alex: Agree on telemetry. For UX, let's avoid hard 413 for now — prefer graceful split or route. Fail early only if bytes>10MB or single item too big. :+1:
Ben: SDK note: many clients pack embeddings arrays without dim header. We should enforce X-Embed-Dim header for fast routing; fallback: perform cheap dim infer from length but warn.
Jordan: I'm comfortable shipping soft-throttle + header enforcement in canary. Jira: PLT-4321 add telemetry + console tile; PLT-4322 throttle config and runtime toggle; PLT-4323 SDK header validation.
Mira: I'll PR telemetry + dashboard mock. Ben — can you add header validation to python/ts SDKs? Alex — can you coordinate canary rollout and toggle?
Alex: Yup — I'll schedule a brief canary next Tue. infra-bot, please track alerts during rollout.
infra-bot: noted: scheduled check created deployment_watch/9470012345 for next_canary
Jordan: Also add an annotation in console tooltip explaining "mixed dims = increased cost/latency". We'll avoid noisy alerts by setting initial alert threshold to 10 events/5m.
Ben: Sounds good. Action items summarized: Mira -> metrics & dashboard, Ben -> SDK header & detect, Jordan -> runtime soft-throttle PR, Alex -> canary rollout & monitoring. :white_check_mark:
